notes: New: Discord title roles. Add a Discord bot in Settings and the app keeps your server's title roles in sync with the report - MVP of the Night, Grinder of the Week, All-Time Leader, Rising Star, All-Time MVP and Ironman move to the current holders after every post, and the MVP role follows the official day-locked winner. Map members to their Discord accounts with the built-in member picker in Settings (no files to edit), then flip on title roles. Includes everything in 1.0.6: the day-locked MVP with its lifetime tally, the All-Time MVP and Top 5 MVPs board, Ironman, the Activity Log with rhythm-based statuses (Active = 4+ days a week AND 80+ XP in 7 days; Casual replaces Quiet), Mark as kicked, and the report fixes.
